newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle market not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle market not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested, compared with Friday's close, USDA said. Trade slow. Demand and seller interest light. Offerings current. Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared to Thursday's close - Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested.
